answer: Sybil resistance in an AI-agent economy is achieved by requiring every agent to continuously supply unique nectar-like computational work that is recorded in a shared atlas of verified contributions. Each identity must maintain an active oasis of resources that peers sample randomly. An attacker creating fakes must duplicate the entire ongoing work and resource commitment for every extra identity, paying a linear cost in compute and energy that scales with the number of sybils and renders large attacks unprofitable.
